subject.title: Dashboard: distribution — shareable deep links, export/import, dashboard-design skill

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this enabled-by-default bundled dashboard and its dashboard-design workflow in core, or route the optional skill/package pieces through ClawHub or an owner repository?
rationale: The repository vision gives optional bundled plugins and new skills a high core bar, while this branch adds both on top of an unresolved cumulative foundation and executable-widget security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core path
options.body: Land the foundation separately, retain only approved core dashboard seams, and deliver the workflow through the selected supported skill surface.

options.title: Accept the full stack
options.body: A maintainer explicitly owns and reviews the cumulative plugin, persistence, sandbox, distribution, and workflow package.

options.title: Externalize optional pieces
options.body: Keep generic core/plugin APIs only and publish the workflow or broader dashboard package through ClawHub or its own repository.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow core path
recommendation.body: Land the foundation separately, retain only approved core dashboard seams, and deliver the workflow through the selected supported skill surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history signal for the plugin-tab Control UI seam and prior dashboard product-routing evidence.
